verdict.rationale: Docusign's core eSignature and CLM features (reusable templates, standardized agreements, identity verification, workflow automation) generically support routing offer letters, NDAs/IP agreements, and other paperwork through signing workflows, and templates can be built for any document type including HR/equity forms. However there is no specific evidence of purpose-built hiring or equity-grant templates, HRIS/ATS integrations, or cap-table/equity-platform connectors (e.g., Carta) that would streamline option grant paperwork specifically. Missing for 10: named HR/hiring template library, equity-management platform integrations, and any case study of running offer/IP/option paperwork end-to-end.
